name: punctum-picture R4 live QA harness
postCreateCommand: npm ci && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y openssl && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium && npx wrangler --version

CLERK_SECRET_KEY.description: Clerk live secret key (sk_live_...). Required by the Clerk browser proof and managed Clerk-link acceptance gates. NAME ONLY; never commit the value.

CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Clerk live publishable key (pk_live_...). Required by the Clerk browser proof and managed Clerk-link gates.

CLERK_ISSUER.description: Clerk issuer URL (https://clerk.punctumpicture.com). Runtime Clerk auth config.

CLERK_JWT_KEY.description: Clerk JWKS / JWT verification key material. Runtime Clerk auth config.

CLERK_AUTHORIZED_PARTIES.description: Comma-separated authorized parties (azp) for Clerk session verification.

SITE_ORIGIN.description: Public site origin used by runtime Clerk auth config (https://punctumpicture.com).

PUNCTUM_QA_ORIGIN.description: Managed QA origin. Must equal the built-in managed hostname (https://aliceblue-locust-999458.hostingersite.com) or the functional gate hard-asserts and fails closed.

PUNCTUM_QA_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Admin email for the managed synthetic functional gate login.

PUNCTUM_QA_TEST_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for the managed synthetic functional gate login.

SOURCE_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Source admin email for the managed acceptance HTTP gate and the managed production Python harness.

SOURCE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Source admin password for the managed acceptance HTTP gate and the managed production Python harness.

HOSTINGER_API.description: Hostinger managed hosting API token used by scripts/hostinger_managed_production.py (via scripts/hostinger_managed_qa.py, which raises if it is unset). Required by the G17 managed production prepare gate.

PUNCTUM_MANAGED_OUTPUT.description: Filesystem path the G17 managed production harness reads exported artifacts from (private-environment.json, export-receipt.json, managed-seed.bin). Read by scripts/hostinger_managed_production.py.

PUNCTUM_CLERK_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Clerk-linked admin email selected by the Clerk production proof identity check.

PUNCTUM_CLERK_ADMIN_USER_ID.description: Clerk admin user id (user_...) selected by the Clerk production proof.

PUNCTUM_CLERK_SESSION_ID.description: Clerk admin session id (sess_...) selected by the Clerk production proof.

PUNCTUM_CLERK_BROWSER_SESSION_JWT.description: Short-lived Clerk session JWT consumed by the browser login/logout/revocation proof.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Cloudflare API token scoped for R2 recovery object reads. Required by the managed recovery download gate.

PUNCTUM_MANAGED_RECOVERY_KEY.description: Hex AES-256-GCM key for the managed recovery export. Required by the recovery download gate.

PUNCTUM_MANAGED_RECOVERY_PREFIX.description: R2 object prefix of the managed recovery export. Required by the recovery download gate.

PUNCTUM_MANAGED_PROBE.description: Managed acceptance probe marker matching /^p[a-f0-9]{6}$/. Required by the managed acceptance HTTP gate.

GITHUB_SHA.description: Source commit SHA stamped into every managed gate report. Set to the branch HEAD you are proving.

GITHUB_RUN_ID.description: Run id stamped into the managed functional synthetic album title.

GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT.description: Run attempt stamped into the managed functional synthetic album title.
